title: tooling(pm): dispatch-gates git maxBuffer for the merged tree; register matchers proven on the nested ui/ rows (4b PR 1, inert)

Also closes the PR A2 item dispatch-gates maxBuffer (the PR A2 bill lives on the CI-wiring card of this epic, which stays open for its other items).

## What this changes

Two inert changes in `scripts/pm/**`. Nothing changes for today's tree: no register row, no instruction file, no CODEOWNERS line and no workflow is touched.

1. **`dispatch-gates.mjs`: git children get a 64 MiB stdout ceiling** (`GIT_MAX_BUFFER_BYTES`), in `runGit` and in `ignoreVerdicts`' `git check-ignore`. `spawnSync`'s default is 1 MiB, and past it the child dies with `ENOBUFS`. Measured: `git ls-files -z` on this tree at 43edf90 is 724,439 bytes (11,967 paths). objectui's tree under a `ui/` prefix adds 631,073 bytes (9,197 paths), so the merged listing is about 1.36 MB, past the default. That is the Lint · PM dispatch-gates red on the verification run of the import. A tree that already fit gets the same answer as before.
2. **The register's matchers take a register handed in.** `governedSurfacesFor(repo, register)`, `governedPathsIn(paths, repo, register)`, `governedTierFor(paths, repo, register)` and the queue guard's `codeownersMirrorVerdict({ …, register })` default to `GOVERNED_SURFACES`. No production caller passes one. It is the seam the self-tests use to drive the six nested `ui/` rows through the real matchers before those rows land on the register. The prose gate's `verdict(region, globs)` already took its register as an argument, so it only gains pins.

## Inventory: `scripts/pm/**` and objectui, what PR 1 does with each

| `check-governed-merges.mjs` | `GOVERNED_REPOS` row `objectui`; `workflows` row scoped to objectstack, objectui, cloud | matchers take an optional `register`; new self-test battery on the six `ui/` rows | default argument is the live register; no row added |
| `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` | imports the register; sibling-copy repo resolution (`guardRepository`) | `codeownersMirrorVerdict` takes an optional `register`; four pins | default argument; CODEOWNERS on disk still mirrors the live register (pinned) |
| `check-governed-prose.mjs` | reads the register's globs for objectstack | three `verdict` pins on the `ui/` globs | no prose region or register change |
| `dispatch-gates.mjs` | `--repo` sister-repo slugs; one comment on `objectui-changeset-digest` | git `maxBuffer` raised | same output on any listing under 1 MiB |
| `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` | fixtures | one slow section: a 16,000-path temporary index | slow tier only (push/schedule in CI) |
| `check-half-states.mjs` | sibling board (`OWN_BOARD === 'objectui'`), repo-qualified refs | none | objectui repo stays open until archive; removal is sub-issue 6 |

| `check-expected-skips.mjs` | `ui_tree` skip reasons from PR A | none | already inert while `ui/` is absent |
| `ci-failure.mjs` · `sweep-*.mjs` · `rerun-failed.mjs` · `record-recognisers.mjs` · `os-regen-merge.sh` · `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` · `changeset-deadline-census.mjs` · `board-snapshot.mjs` | comments and fixtures | none | text only |

## Deferred to PR 2: the six `ui/` register rows

Decided by the epic PM: the rows land in PR 2, not here. Adding a register row is not a `scripts/pm`-only change. Measured on 43edf90:

- `check:pm-governed-prose` requires every register glob as a code span in `AGENTS.md` Prime Directive #14 and in the pm-dispatch `SKILL.md` ACCEPT region.
- The queue guard's CODEOWNERS mirror pin requires a root-anchored line for every Tier H row.
- `check:pm-skill-ratchet` has `AGENTS.md` at 1117/1117 lines and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` at 319/319, both with headroom 0 and a 120-byte line cap.

The six globs come to about 115 bytes, which is one more line in each file. PR 2's `AGENTS.md` rewrite (the 41 `objectui#` mentions and the sibling-repo sections) frees those lines without a ceiling raise.

The rows, as PR 2 lands them (all Tier H, `repos: ['objectstack']`). They mirror objectui's own six-row register under `ui/`:

| id | match | glob |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-adr` | prefix `ui/docs/adr/` | `ui/docs/adr/**` |
| `ui-claude-tree` | prefix `ui/.claude/` | `ui/.claude/**` |
| `ui-skills-catalog` | prefix `ui/skills/` | `ui/skills/**` |
| `ui-agents-md` | exact `ui/AGENTS.md` | `ui/AGENTS.md` |
| `ui-claude-md` | exact `ui/CLAUDE.md` | `ui/CLAUDE.md` |
| `ui-workflows` | prefix `ui/.github/workflows/` | `ui/.github/workflows/**` |

- `ui/.claude/**` is Tier H, not S. That content lands Tier H in objectui today, and Tier S would loosen its landing, which is a maintainer ruling (one field, `tier`).
- `ui/.changeset/config.json` is left out. No register in either repository governs `.changeset/config.json`.
- PR 2 also adds the six CODEOWNERS lines (`/ui/docs/adr/`, `/ui/.claude/`, `/ui/skills/`, `/ui/AGENTS.md`, `/ui/CLAUDE.md`, `/ui/.github/workflows/`) and flips this PR's pin `today-the-register-does-not-know-ui-the-pr-adding-the-rows-flips-this`.
- **The window:** between the subtree import and PR 2, nothing in this repository governs those `ui/` paths. The cutover freeze sequences it as subtree PR, then PR B of the CI-wiring card, then this card's PR 2, then 4a. So `ui/**` is governed before anything else merges on top of it.

## Verification

Tree: `faaeaeb` on `main` 43edf90 (merge base = `origin/main`).

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 527 assertions (512 before). New battery: 15 cases. Each `ui/` row's specimen is governed by its own row alone and lands Tier H, including `ui/.claude/hooks/…` with a root `.claude/**` path beside it. `ui/packages/…/src`, `ui/package.json` and `ui/.changeset/config.json` are not governed. Nested copies (`ui/examples/AGENTS.md`, `ui/packages/x/.github/workflows/w.yml`) and near misses stay out. Root rows and `ui/` rows do not reach each other. The rows govern objectstack alone. Today's register knows no `ui/` path. Roster floor 34 → 35.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 339 cases (335 before). With the `ui/` rows handed in, the CODEOWNERS file on disk is short by exactly one line per `ui/` row, and each problem names the row and its `/ui/…` pattern. A fixture carrying those lines passes. The sibling repository's verdict needs no `/ui/` line.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-prose.mjs --self-test` and the gate: exit 0, 31 cases. With the `ui/` globs named in the prose, both halves pass. With the globs on the register but not in the prose, all six are missing. With them in the prose ahead of the register, the four `**` globs are over-claims.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test` (both tiers): exit 0, 2178 cases pass (fast 1913 in 261 s, slow 265 in 744 s). The new slow section stages a 16,000-path index (1.5 MiB listing). CONTROL: the same `git ls-files -z` spawned with the default buffer dies with `ENOBUFS`. `trackedFiles` returns all 16,000 paths, first and last byte-identical.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: exit 0, not governed, +136 / −11 over 5 files.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 39 commands): every one exit 0. Record:

## Acceptance notes

- `check:pm-dispatch-gates` runs the fast tier locally and on PR/queue CI. The new maxBuffer section is slow-tier, so CI runs it on `push` to `main` and on `schedule`. The local both-tier run above is the PR-time evidence.
- `.github/CODEOWNERS` routes `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` and `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` to the approvers (enforcement-chain rows), so a code-owner review is requested when this leaves draft. Neither file is a register surface, and this PR is not Tier H (`--branch` above).
- No changeset: `scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).
